translation.name: Healer's kit
profile: A healer's kit is ordinary specialist equipment for a character who helps treat injuries. In Elaria, it may be prepared by a teacher, local healer, or experienced traveling group. Its appearance and contents can express a tradition or connection to home without changing the specific bonus listed in the catalog.

It helps with an ordinary treatment test, but is not itself a healing spell and does not automatically restore hit points. The character must identify whom they are helping and the actual situation. The kit may become part of an adventure if it is missing from an isolated settlement, belongs to a vanished healer, or supplies must be delivered safely to helpers.

Rules effect: +2 INT to an ordinary injury-treatment test. The price is 2 gp. The item is reusable rather than a single-use supply. Its listed effect applies to the situation it is intended for. Additional bonuses, other forms of protection, and new magical abilities are not part of this entry.

strings.Přesný řádek této položky má přednost př: This item's exact entry overrides the general formula only where explicitly stated. Vaelor does not add any further hidden bonuses.
This item's effects, requirements, and price.
strings.Lze použít i jako vrhací zbraň: Can also be used as a thrown weapon
strings.+2 O při lezení nebo překonávání překážk: +2 AGI when climbing or overcoming an obstacle, if the rope can be used meaningfully
strings.Poskytuje světlo v okolí: Provides light in the surrounding area
strings.Umožňuje běžně rozdělat oheň: Allows an ordinary fire to be lit
+2 STR when prying open doors, crates, and similar obstacles
strings.+2 O k testu lezení, pokud ji lze použít: +2 AGI to a climbing test, if the kit can be used
strings.+2 S při kopání nebo odstraňování zeminy: +2 STR when digging or removing earth
strings.+2 CH k orientaci v krajině: +2 INT to navigating in the wilderness
strings.+2 CH k orientaci v zobrazené oblasti: +2 INT for navigation in the mapped area
strings.+2 CH k běžnému testu ošetření zranění: +2 INT to an ordinary injury-treatment test
